rules.domain gates the count vocabulary: a count key is only read as a population inside a study already measured to enumerate a directory -- E207/E208 showed the name alone is not evidence
rules.address: a face names its corpus when it carries corpus{pin_id,members}; a block without a pin id is not an address
rules.seam: replay needs build(files=...) -- E363 can only re-run a study that exposes one
rules.no_rebuild: nothing is rebuilt here; every number is read from the published face or from the producer's own source

limits.name_vocabulary: count keys are matched by substring, so a population named outside CENSUS_WORDS is invisible to this table (it understates, never invents)
limits.unresolved_studies: a study whose producer declares no STUDY constant and whose file name does not start with the study id is reported UNRESOLVED rather than guessed
limits.faces_without_a_study_field: the mirror is read, not the dated vintage; a face published without a study field is out of scope
limits.seam_is_static: has_files_seam reads the source text, so a build() that takes files and ignores it would still read as a seam
